articles.title: Adani signs 3-year copper supply deal with Attero: Report
articles.description: Adani has entered a three-year agreement with Attero worth about $1 billion for copper anode supply. This collaboration aims to decrease the smelter's reliance on copper imports by approximately 5%. The deal, undisclosed until recently, supports the expansion of the Kutch Copper facility in Gujarat. Attero will produce copper anode by recycling metals from electronic waste and batteries.
